rationale: Matches this codebase's established convention that every idle/disable-style knob (subprocess_utils.py idle_timeout, config/automation.py idle_timeout_seconds, parallel/types.py idle_timeout_per_issue) defaults to 0/disabled and requires explicit non-zero opt-in; Option B (a measured-cadence global default) has no data source anywhere in the codebase and contradicts FEAT-3033's own start-at-zero schema design.
rule: Option A: gate the or-3600 wall-clock-cap relaxation on explicit idle_timeout/default_idle_timeout opt-in
alternatives_rejected: Option B: ship a non-zero default_idle_timeout chosen from measured agent-output cadence, applied unconditionally to every prompt state
